arxiv-1908-03583.title: An Empirical Guide to the Behavior and Use of Scalable Persistent Memory
arxiv-1908-03583.creator: Jian Yang, Juno Kim, Morteza Hoseinzadeh, Joseph Izraelevitz, Steven Swanson
arxiv-1908-03583.description: Abstract After nearly a decade of anticipation, scalable nonvolatile memory DIMMs are finally commercially available with the release of Intel’s 3D XPoint DIMM. This new nonvolatile DIMM supports byte-granularity accesses with access times on the order of DRAM, while also providing data storage that survives power outages. Researchers have not idly waited for real nonvolatile DIMMs (NVDIMMs) to arrive.

arxiv-2402-16631.description: Abstract genai ( genai ) and communication networks are expected to have groundbreaking synergies for 6G. Connecting genai agents via a wireless network can potentially unleash the power of ci ( ci ) and pave the way for agi ( agi ).

arxiv-2512-11236.title: The Response of Rotating Stellar Convection to Latitudinally-Varying Heat Flux
arxiv-2512-11236.creator: Kinfe Teweldebirhan, Rituparna Curt, Nicholas A. Featherstone
arxiv-2512-11236.description: Abstract We investigate how rotating convection responds to the imposition of a latitudinally-varying heat flux at the base of the convective layer. This study is motivated by the solar near-surface shear layer, whose flows are thought to transition from a buoyancy-dominated regime near the photosphere to a rotation-dominated regime at depth.

pmc-10568309.creator: Monica Ballarino, Gerardo Pepe, Manuela Helmer-Citterich, Alessandro Palma
pmc-10568309.description: In recent years, research on long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) has gained considerable attention due to the increasing number of newly identified transcripts. Several characteristics make their functional evaluation challenging, which called for the urgent need to combine molecular biology with other disciplines, including bioinformatics.

pmc-10714612.title: Construction and validation of a predictive model for the risk of bowel resection in adults with incarcerated groin hernia
pmc-10714612.creator: Zheqi Zhou, Yujie Li, Bin Li, Likun Yan, Yingying Lei, Cong Tong
pmc-10714612.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). BackgroundIt is difficult to definitively determine the degree of ischemia in the bowel in which an incarcerated groin hernia is embedded. Failure to diagnose and intervene promptly and accurately increases the rate of bowel resection and patient mortality.

pmc-11487700.title: Assessing well-being of university students and evaluation of its determinants
pmc-11487700.creator: Orsolya Szepe, Agnes Meszaros
pmc-11487700.description: BackgroundOur study aimed to examine the well-being of students studying at the three (non-medical) faculties of Semmelweis University Budapest, to analyse the relationships between well-being, stress, emotional support, sleep patterns, sport, and further variables like smoking, consumption of sleeping pills, sedatives, psychoactive agents, energy drinks, and exam anxiety.

pmc-11495826.title: Re-evaluation of Microhardness of Mineral Trioxide Aggregate and Biodentine After Removal From Root Using Different Types of Solvents: An In Vitro Study
pmc-11495826.creator: Ruchali S Bhandare, Sudha B Mattigatti
pmc-11495826.description: ObjectiveThis study aimed to evaluate the effects of different solvents on the microhardness of mineral trioxide aggregate (MTA) and Biodentine, which are used in endodontic therapy for their biocompatibility and ability to create a hermetic seal.MethodsA total of 150 extracted human single-rooted teeth were selected and sectioned into 4 mm slices.

pmc-12606724.title: Stress-induced tip engineering of micro-hyperbolic structures for enhanced liquid repellency
pmc-12606724.creator: Chorong Kim, Yoonjin Lee, Jaekyoung Kim, Ji Hoon Kim, Hyunsik Yoon
pmc-12606724.description: Surface functionality in micro- and nanostructured materials is highly sensitive to geometric modifications, yet methods that enable fine structural tuning through facile and scalable fabrication remain limited. We report a method to induce controlled tip bending in micro-hyperbolic (MH) structures via metal-specific thin film deposition.

pmc-12619441.title: Clinical efficacy and impact on sexual function of percutaneous endoscopic lumbar discectomy in the treatment of male lumbar disc herniation complicated with cauda equina syndrome
pmc-12619441.creator: Juyi Lai, Yuanfei Fu, Huangsheng Tan, Pengwei Deng, Hualong Feng, Zhiming Lan, Jun Tao, Shenghua He
pmc-12619441.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). PurposeTo investigate the surgical efficacy of Percutaneous Endoscopic Lumbar Discectomy (PELD) versus Interlaminar Fenestration Decompression (IFD) in treating male patients with Lumbar Disc Herniation (LDH) complicated with Cauda Equina Syndrome (CES), and to evaluate their impact on sexual function.MethodsA retrospective analysis was conducted on male patients with LDH complicated with CES who underwent PELD or IFD at Shenzhen Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital from January 2014 to December 2022.

pmc-13682475.title: Guanidine-quaternary ammonium polymer-derived carbon dots differentially modulate bacterial respiration and osteoblast mitochondria to resolve infection and foster osteointegration
pmc-13682475.creator: Xinxin Bai, Anhui Qin, Zhenguo Wang, Guang Kong, Menghan Zhang, Hongyu Li, Rui Zhao, Yue Yu, Yongfeng Zhang, Qi Liu, Ziqing Zhu, Bing Xia, Shengyou Li, Yiming Hao, Mingze Qin, Dong Lei, Lingli Guo, Meijia Su, Zhuojing Luo, Shaohuang Weng, Teng Ma, Jinghui Huang
pmc-13682475.description: Implant-associated infections (IAIs) represent one of the most challenging complications following orthopedic implantation. Current antibacterial strategies struggle to achieve complete pathogen eradication while maintaining sustained osteogenic activity at the implant-bone interface. Leveraging the spatial divergence in energy metabolism between prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, we designed and synthesized guanidine-quaternary ammonium polymer-derived carbon dots (GQCDs) with confirmed structure.
